svg.title: CFTR DNA and translation with three-base deletion bracket
svg.desc: Simplified transcription of the supplied sequence figure, preserving its 1186 to 314 aspect ratio. Four DNA rows begin at 1441, 1501, 1561, and 1621. The corresponding amino-acid rows end at residues 456, 476, 496, and 516. On the last row, ATCATCTTTGGT is highlighted in yellow; an orange square bracket marks CTT, the three deleted bases. Other source dots and rules are omitted.
